name: Void Touched - Kassadin
creator: deepd0wn
description:
# 🌑 VOID TOUCHED - KASSADIN 🌑
A massive visual upgrade for base skin Kassadin.

This skin upgrades Kassadin's dated model with high detail void corruption artwork and glowing visuals. The in game splash art looks nothing like the model, this mod aims to bring the two together. This also serves to update Kassadin to the new colors used in most void faction champions.

I encourage you to do a side by side comparison to really see the improvement of the VFX, model and splashart.

## Features:
- An HD model corrupted and warped by the powers of the void
- Upscaled VFX with rich colors to match Kassadin's visuals 
- New splash art and slightly recolored icons

Before and after photos in the gallery!
